fallback_if_geometry_failure: M00015, selected on geometry only; do not choose using a favorable partial trajectory
control: M00000, unchanged J00008 sequence given exactly the same refinement
external_fold_control: NATIVE_3EAK; original CDRs never used as design seeds
outcome: Complete-production mean loop CA RMSD after framework alignment. Both replicate outcomes and per-CDR values must be reported; no selected early interval.
evidence_language: Lower displacement is a short-stress-test result, not a folding free energy, equilibrium ensemble, thermostability measurement, or expression prediction. Two replicas do not establish statistical significance.
contingency: If the stricter thermal rule is not met, do not label a sequence stabilized. Model-supported candidates may still be reserves, with evidence separated from sequence novelty and biological validation.
